messages: sara: Quick All-Hands follow-up on hybrid/remote + travel stuff. I'm consolidating answers here. If you have other questions, drop them and we'll add to the FAQ. :sparkles: emma: Thx! One ask from Eng: can leads require X in-office days for project kickoffs? Is that a manager-only decision? sara: Managers can set team-level expectations (kickoffs, planning weeks). If you need cross-team alignment or space blocks, loop in your GM and Facilities. ben: Do we need to post recurring team days to the company calendar or just team calendars? raj: Team calendar is fine unless you need building resources or affect other teams. Claire: What about international travel quarantines / local regs? If someone's returning from a trip, are there paid quarantine days? sara: We don't have a blanket quarantine-paid-days policy. For company-mandated travel where local rules require isolation, People Ops will handle case-by-case and will aim to be flexible. Put a note in the travel form "quarantine_needs" so we can flag it. ops-bot: Reminder: travel requests should be submitted 21 days ahead for domestic travel, 35 days for international when visas are needed. sara: Visa support confirmed: People Ops issues invitation letters and we reimburse visa fees if pre-approved on the travel form (field name: visa_support). emma: Any guidance on bringing partners/family to offsites? Is there an official subsidized policy? ben: We're running a limited partner/childcare stipend pilot for 2026 offsites; eligibility will be on the offsite page. Managers can request exceptions for critical contributors. raj: Logistics Q: can teams reserve a cluster of conference rooms for a week of workshops? Facilities process? sara: Yes — submit a facilities request and note "offsite-week". Facilities needs 7 business days to coordinate AV and badge access. claire: Parking / commuter stipend status? I heard SF pilot ended. sara: Correct, SF/Denver pilots end this quarter; any expansion will be announced with 30 days' notice. For recurring parking needs we do case-by-case reviews. ops-bot: Expense tip: use project code EXP-OFFSITE-2026 to speed reimbursements. ben: Who approves exceptions for date changes or extra nights? sara: Manager + People Ops for operational exceptions. Budget exceptions escalate to Finance and GM. emma: ADA accommodations? Confidential process? sara: Yes — contact People Ops privately and we'll arrange accommodations confidentially. raj: Can we get a short checklist for managers about setting team in-office norms (communication, equity, cross-team impacts)? sara: I'll publish a manager checklist and update the hybrid FAQ by next Wednesday, then ping eng-leads and this channel. emma: Also request: preferred vendor list for flights/hotels so we can book group rates. sara: We'll include the vendor list in the travel form dropdown. If a vendor is missing, choose "other" and tag procurement (cc: ben). ops-bot: Tip: for international bookings that need POs, contact finance@redwood and cc procurement. claire: Thanks all, this helps. sara: Thanks everyone — keep Qs coming. If you need a private follow-up, DM me or Ben.
